meta.tagline: 一把被落在公交车上的黄伞，晴天里在失物招领的货架上等了一整天，暴雨回来时和另外 312 把一起撑开：物件、交通、天气和标识，都是卡着节拍的几何象形符号。

spec.upstream_line: A yellow umbrella left on a bus waits out a sunny day on the lost-property shelf, then opens with 312 others when the storm comes back: objects, vehicles, weather and signs as beat-locked geometric pictograms.
